title: Ratsasan
desc: Following his father's death, a man gives up on his dream to become a filmmaker and joins the police force. He then attempts to track down a psychopathic killer who targets schoolgirls.

title: Masss
desc: After a life-threatening accident, a man finds that he can communicate with the dead, and must decide whether to act on their advice.

title: Ghilli
desc: An aspiring kabaddi player travels to Madurai to participate in a regional match, where he rescues Dhanalakshmi from Muthupandi, a powerful man who wants to marry the girl against her will.

title: Rajini Murugan
desc: Rajini Murugan loves Karthika, but her father objects to their alliance due to a confusion.

title: Kuruvi
desc: Vitrivel becomes caught in a web of crime and violence when he tracks down a man who holds his father as bonded labour along with many innocent people.
